main_text.p: [illegible, ~8 letters] conciliantia argumenta.cere maximè folent. In cóciliando deniq; illud curandũ,vt non ridere aut contem-nere,sed magnifacere amici expostulatio nem videamur,ideoq; sententiæ vsurpâdę[?], q pudorem & verecundiâ declarant: q dolorem ac tristitiâ,indicant: execrationem contineant & detestatione eius q, obiici-tur:laudem deniq; atq; commedationem complectuntur illorū apud quos purgare nos volumus:q ab æquitate,prudentia,iustitia, manfuetudine,clementia ducetur. Ac propterea locum hîc maximè habent admirationes,detestationes,imprecatio-nes,indignationes,pollicitationes & his similia alia,quibus & excusatio fit morata & venia facilè impetratur. Interdū etiâ accusatio est acerbitatis in respondendo mutua instituenda,& culpa in eius, q nobiscum p literas expostulauit,morositate aut iniquitatem transferenda. Collocatio argumentorum.Collocatio autè atq; tractatio talis erit: vt prima pars exordiū,constet: aut significatione doloris ex accusatione & reprehensione amici percepta. lib.2.epist.1. Aut occasione scribendi.lib.10. epist.34. Aut reprehensione institutæ expostulationis. li.7.epi.27. Aut excusatione silentij & infrequetiæ litera-rum,lib,7.epist,13.lib,10.epist.31,Aut obte-

page.notes: Marginal Greek word at the top left is printed but not legible enough to read reliably; marked illegible. Words marked [?]: "vsurpâdę" and the abbreviated "sententiæ" (printed as "fentétiæ"), where the tilde and accent are uncertain. The line "statione" at the right below the text is the catchword, not running text. The main text ends on the half word "obte-". Printed errors left as they are: "li.7.epi.27.", "lib,7.epist,13.lib,10.epist.31,Aut", "infrequetiæ", "morositate" (printed as "morofitate").
